Strategic focus: Dative case. 'Постели' takes the dative after 'к' to show direction toward the bed. 'Больного' is the genitive showing whose bed it is.

Strategic focus: Nominative as bedding. 'Постель' here means bedding and stays nominative as the subject. 'Чистая' is the agreeing feminine adjective, and 'в шкафу' gives the location.
Strategic focus: Genitive singular after numeral. 'Постели' follows 'две', which requires the genitive singular for feminine nouns. 'Новые' takes the nominative plural form typical with два and две.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after quantity. 'Постелей' is the genitive plural after 'много', taking the -ей ending for soft feminine nouns. 'Свежих' agrees in the genitive plural.
Strategic focus: Nominative description. 'Постель' is nominative as the subject. 'Мягкая' is the agreeing feminine adjective, reinforced by 'очень'. A clean descriptive model.
